searchText: not sure if this is the right place to ask this, but could anyone please point me to a reliable source to check the EL side client diversity related percentages ? are the distributions showed on ethernodes & rated network reliable enough? In fact, it is still possible to pass this even with the block limit remaining unchanged. For example, if a full block is followed by an empty block, the net change in the base fee is (100% + 12.5%)(100% - 12.5%) < 100%
